purpose: Operator record of nowcast day-max values rejected because their input was bad (audit 2026-09-27-a1 R5). forecast/nowcast.py drops a candidate whose (day_local, day_max_utc) appears here and falls through to the next-best candidate. Entries are append-only; add a new entry rather than editing one.

rejections.reason: Modeled street maximum driven by a bay input of 6.677 ft NAVD88 stamped 'observed' at 02:40 local (nowcast runs 05:31Z-07:21Z carried 4.633, 5.667, 6.677 ft). NOAA's Sandy Hook series for that window has the bay at 0.2-0.8 ft NAVD88 and The Battery ebbing smoothly; none of those values exist in the retained series. Not a street measurement; the tape crest that morning was 5.62 ft NAVD88 (+25.2 in) at 09:44-10:06 local.

rejections.note: Recorded on the review branch audit/2026-09-27-a1-reply at ~21:45Z on 2026-09-27; not live at recording. Until the branch merges, the published nowcast and the public 'so far today' line keep showing this value for the day it belongs to; the local-midnight rollover retires it from the line regardless. Record the actual cutover (merge time or rollover) here when observed.
rejections.cutover: Merged to main in c2569c07a at 2026-09-28T02:47:16Z (Codex round 11 approval); GitHub Pages served the new code by 02:50Z with the public 'so far today' line reading MEASURED +25.2 in at 09:44. At write time (02:55Z) the latest published nowcast was still the pre-merge run 2026-09-28T02:38:13Z (day max 39.0 @ 2026-09-27T06:40:00Z); the first post-merge nowcast run will apply the rejection. The line's local-midnight rollover (04:00Z) retires the value regardless.

cutover_verifications.result: Both carried 39.0-in candidates logged as rejected; published nowcast has no day_max fields. Verified before local midnight rollover. Historical measured crest remains in forecast.json.
